name: lesson-citation
title: Lesson Citation
description: Read a cited lesson passage and return to the exercise.
useCases: Below a tutor’s reply, a student expands a citation and checks the explanation against the original lesson passage.
In an exercise review, a reader opens the referenced textbook section. The app can take them back to the marked location through onReturn.
task: Read a cited lesson passage and return to the exercise.
behavior: Supply a title, source locator, excerpt and link. Use onReturn to restore the relevant application view.
